opening.argument: The presentation centers on a sniper and front-running bot, advertised as capable of “x10+BNB,” and directs viewers to fund the contract with BNB to activate automated trading. The workflow is presented as automatically buying and selling, with proceeds returned to the viewer’s wallet, while the description asserts that 90% of profit is transferred back. The claimed upside is unusually high: an approximately fifteen-times result, personal gains of several hundred BNB, and the possibility of upwards of 100 BNB per day. Although it acknowledges gas and burn-fee risks and recommends at least 1 BNB, those qualifications do not remove the funding-for-profit solicitation or the promised trading returns.
